title: The Once and Future Nerd
description: A portal-fantasy epic that starts with genre familiarity and then digs into politics, class, war, and the limits of trying to fix a world you barely understand.
coverAlt: The Once and Future Nerd cover art

similarReasons.midnight-burger: Both reward listeners who want warmth, humor, and a larger moral imagination beneath the weirdness.
similarReasons.the-waystation: A strong fit if the listener wants thoughtful worldbuilding and characters living inside larger systems.
similarReasons.victoriocity: Useful if the draw is sharp world texture and a cast navigating a setting bigger than the immediate plot.

archiveTake: Worth the commitment if you want fantasy that grows well past its premise and keeps getting more politically textured.

metadata.importOfficialSummary: Today’s bonus content is the #AskTOAFN listener Q&A for Book 2, Chapter 9. Christian, Dan, Anya and Greg answer a few questions related to the chapter…and then mostly relitigate Tumblr’s “Sexiest Once And Future Nerd Character” poll. ANNOUNCEMENTS: Due to a (very literal) expansion in the TOAFN family, there will be a longer than usual break between Chapters 9 and 10. Our Patreon will be paused until we have something to release. Stay tuned to our socials for official announcements. (The transcript for the conversation can be found  here , and the transcript for our announcements can be found  here .) Thank you as always for listening!
